text:
Jordan: Hey team — finishing up my first week and running into a few access things. My Google Drive doesn't show the 'redwood-team' shared folder, Okta shows 'no app assigned' on my dashboard, and my 1Password invite expired. Who should I ping to get these sorted? cc @Tara (IT)

Tara (IT): Hey Jordan — sorry about that. Can you DM me your employee ID? Did you get the welcome email from it@redwood with the Drive link? Sometimes the Google group sync lags after provisioning.

Jordan: I do have the welcome email but the link says 'You need access'. Employee ID is RWD-4821.

DevOnboardBot: Created ticket IT-1234 for Jordan — status: triage. ETA for group fix ~2 hours. If you need something sooner, Tara can add a manual share.

Tara (IT): Thanks. @DevOnboardBot can you trigger a group sync? If not I'll add him directly to the folder. Jordan, also try signing out of Google and back in (or incognito) while we work this.

Jordan: Tried incognito + relog, still says no access. Okta still shows 'no apps assigned' (screenshot sent).

Samir: For 1Password invites, if the link expires you can resend from the 1Password admin: Settings > Invitations > Resend. If that doesn't work, Tara can provision a seat and I can share a temporary vault until it's fixed.

Tara (IT): Resent 1Password invite to jordan@redwood.com and manually added him to 'redwood-team' Drive as Viewer. Check now and tell me if you can access the folder.

Jordan: Got the 1Password invite and accepted it — working now, thanks. Drive is visible too, thank you! Okta still shows no apps though.

Tara (IT): Okta app assignment depends on HR->Okta sync. I kicked a sync and assigned the core apps to RWD-4821. Try logging in again in 5 minutes and let me know if you still see that banner. If it persists, tell me the exact error text.

Jordan: Looks good now, apps appeared. Quick question: for MFA, should I set up a passkey or wait for my YubiKey (shipping next week)?

Samir: Passkeys are the recommended primary method for day-to-day. YubiKey is fine to add for a second factor or if you want a hardware token. Okta supports both — you can enroll passkey now and attach YubiKey later.

Tara (IT): Closing IT-1234 since Drive + 1Password + Okta are resolved. If anything else pops up, reopen the ticket or ping me. Welcome aboard! :tada:
